name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection — Information security management systems

families.name: Organizational Controls
families.description: 37 controls covering policies, roles, threat intelligence, classification, identity, and supplier management

controls.name: Policies for Information Security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved, published, and communicated

controls.name: Information Security Roles
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated

controls.name: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated

controls.name: Management Responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require personnel to apply information security in accordance with policy

controls.name: Contact with Authorities
controls.description: Establish contacts with relevant authorities

controls.name: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.description: Maintain contacts with specialist security forums and associations

controls.name: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Collect and analyze information about threats to information security

controls.name: Information Security in Project Management
controls.description: Integrate information security into project management

controls.name: Inventory of Information Assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and associated assets shall be developed and maintained

controls.name: Acceptable Use of Assets
controls.description: Rules for acceptable use of information and assets shall be identified and documented

controls.name: Return of Assets
controls.description: Personnel shall return organizational assets on change or termination

controls.name: Classification of Information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to information security needs

controls.name: Labelling of Information
controls.description: Appropriate set of procedures for labelling shall be developed

controls.name: Information Transfer
controls.description: Rules, procedures, and agreements for information transfer shall be in place

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access shall be established

controls.name: Identity Management
controls.description: Full lifecycle of identities shall be managed

controls.name: Authentication Information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled

controls.name: Access Rights
controls.description: Access rights shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed

controls.name: Supplier Relationships
controls.description: Processes for managing information security risks from suppliers shall be defined

controls.name: ICT Supply Chain
controls.description: Address information security within supplier agreements

controls.name: Managing Supplier Services
controls.description: Monitor, review, and manage changes to supplier services

controls.name: Cloud Service Management
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit of cloud services shall be established

controls.name: Information Security for Cloud
controls.description: Information security requirements for cloud services shall be established

controls.name: Incident Management Planning
controls.description: Plan and prepare for managing information security incidents

controls.name: Assessment of Security Events
controls.description: Assess information security events and decide classification

controls.name: Response to Security Incidents
controls.description: Respond to information security incidents according to documented procedures

controls.name: Learning from Incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from incidents shall be used to strengthen controls

controls.name: Collection of Evidence
controls.description: Procedures for identification, collection, and preservation of evidence

controls.name: Information Security During Disruption
controls.description: Plan how to maintain information security during disruption

controls.name: ICT Readiness for Continuity
controls.description: Plan, implement, maintain and test ICT readiness for business continuity

controls.name: Legal & Regulatory Requirements
controls.description: Identify and comply with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements

controls.name: Intellectual Property
controls.description: Implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights

controls.name: Protection of Records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification

controls.name: Privacy and PII
controls.description: Identify and meet requirements for privacy and PII protection

controls.name: Independent Review
controls.description: Organization's approach to managing information security shall be independently reviewed

controls.name: Compliance with Policies
controls.description: Compliance with policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed

controls.name: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures shall be documented and available

families.name: People Controls
families.description: 8 controls covering screening, employment terms, awareness, disciplinary, and remote working

controls.name: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on candidates shall be carried out

controls.name: Terms of Employment
controls.description: Employment agreements shall state information security responsibilities

controls.name: Security Awareness & Training
controls.description: Personnel shall receive appropriate security awareness education and training

controls.name: Disciplinary Process
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be established for information security violations

controls.name: Responsibilities After Termination
controls.description: Responsibilities that remain valid after termination shall be defined and enforced

controls.name: Confidentiality Agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements shall be identified and documented

controls.name: Remote Working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel work remotely

controls.name: Information Security Event Reporting
controls.description: Personnel shall report observed information security events

families.name: Physical Controls
families.description: 14 controls covering perimeters, entry, offices, monitoring, equipment, and secure areas

controls.name: Physical Security Perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas with information

controls.name: Physical Entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls

controls.name: Securing Offices and Rooms
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented

controls.name: Physical Security Monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access

controls.name: Protection Against Physical Threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats shall be designed and implemented

controls.name: Working in Secure Areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented

controls.name: Clear Desk and Screen
controls.description: Clear desk for papers and clear screen for information processing facilities

controls.name: Equipment Siting
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce environmental risks

controls.name: Security of Assets Off-Premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected

controls.name: Storage Media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through lifecycle consistently with classification

controls.name: Supporting Utilities
controls.description: Facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions

controls.name: Cabling Security
controls.description: Cables carrying data shall be protected from interception and damage

controls.name: Equipment Maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure continued availability and integrity

controls.name: Secure Disposal of Equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be securely disposed

families.name: Technological Controls
families.description: 34 controls covering endpoints, access rights, authentication, capacity, malware, vulnerability, logging, network, web, and secure coding

controls.name: User Endpoint Devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via endpoint devices shall be protected

controls.name: Privileged Access Rights
controls.description: Allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed

controls.name: Information Access Restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application functions shall be restricted per policy

controls.name: Access to Source Code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code and development tools shall be managed

controls.name: Secure Authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established

controls.name: Capacity Management
controls.description: Use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted per capacity requirements

controls.name: Protection Against Malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by awareness

controls.name: Technical Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities shall be obtained and evaluated

controls.name: Configuration Management
controls.description: Configurations including security configurations shall be established and managed

controls.name: Information Deletion
controls.description: Information stored in systems shall be deleted when no longer required

controls.name: Data Masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with applicable policies

controls.name: Data Leakage Prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems and networks

controls.name: Information Backup
controls.description: Backup copies shall be maintained and regularly tested

controls.name: Redundancy of Information Processing
controls.description: Sufficient redundancy shall be implemented to meet availability requirements

controls.name: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and events shall be produced and protected

controls.name: Monitoring Activities
controls.description: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour

controls.name: Clock Synchronization
controls.description: Clocks of information processing systems shall be synchronized to approved sources

controls.name: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.description: Use of utility programs capable of overriding controls shall be restricted

controls.name: Software Installation on Operational Systems
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented to control installation of software

controls.name: Networks Security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled

controls.name: Security of Network Services
controls.description: Security mechanisms and service levels of network services shall be identified

controls.name: Segregation of Networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users, and systems shall be segregated

controls.name: Web Filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content

controls.name: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for effective use of cryptography shall be defined and implemented

controls.name: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Rules for secure development shall be established and applied

controls.name: Application Security Requirements
controls.description: Requirements for development or acquisition shall include security

controls.name: Secure System Architecture
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established and applied

controls.name: Secure Coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development

controls.name: Security Testing
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in development

controls.name: Outsourced Development
controls.description: Organization shall direct, monitor, and review outsourced development

controls.name: Separation of Environments
controls.description: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated

controls.name: Change Management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities shall be subject to change management

controls.name: Test Information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed

controls.name: Audit System Protection
controls.description: Audit tests and activities involving operational systems shall be planned

changes_summary: Restructured Annex A from 14 domains to 4 themes (Organizational, People, Physical, Technological), reduced from 114 to 93 controls, added 11 new controls
